clues.text: After the spies returned to Moses, he quieted the people and said Israel could certainly conquer the land.
God said this servant had a different spirit and followed Him wholeheartedly, so he would enter the promised land.
He told Joshua at Gilgal he was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea as a spy.
At age eighty-five, he told Joshua he was still as strong for war as when Moses sent him.
Joshua blessed this man of the tribe of Judah and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
He drove the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, out of Hebron.
He offered his daughter Acsah in marriage to whoever captured Kiriath-sepher, and she later received springs from him.
